subject.title: fix(plugins): keep openclaw chunks native in jiti

question: Should OpenClaw accept `nativeModules: ["openclaw"]` as the shared jiti boundary for plugin-loaded OpenClaw package chunks before landing this PR?
rationale: The dependency contract supports the option and the linked issue is source-reproducible, but this deliberately changes the shared plugin-loader module graph for existing plugin execution paths.

options.title: Replay and land after cleanup
options.body: Remove the release-owned changelog entry, rebase or replay the narrow loader diff onto current main, rerun focused proof, and land if the compatibility boundary is accepted.

options.title: Request packaged marker proof
options.body: Ask for a current packaged before/after marker run if source-level and Crabbox test proof are not enough for this loader contract.

options.title: Pause native boundary
options.body: Hold or close the PR if maintainers decide any supported plugin behavior depends on OpenClaw chunks being evaluated inside jiti's cache.

recommendation.title: Replay and land after cleanup
recommendation.body: Remove the release-owned changelog entry, rebase or replay the narrow loader diff onto current main, rerun focused proof, and land if the compatibility boundary is accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the current PR replay commits, recent shared loader-helper history, and already left the live maintainer-sweep recommendation for this PR.
